mapper.select: SELECT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, u.PASSWORD, f.`FUNCTION`, m.MARKET FROM hdoc_user_infor u LEFT JOIN HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH f ON u.USERID = f.USERID LEFT JOIN hdoc_market_auth m ON m.USERID = f.USERID AND m.`TYPE` = CASE f.`FUNCTION` WHEN 'User Administrator' THEN 'A' WHEN 'RULES' THEN 'R' WHEN 'TEMPLATE' THEN 'T' WHEN 'USER' THEN 'U' WHEN 'Document' THEN 'D' WHEN 'ADAPTATION DOC' THEN 'DOCMOD' WHEN 'market super user' THEN 'MCSU' END WHERE u.USERID = #{userid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH (USERID, `FUNCTION`, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS) VALUES (#{userid}, #{function}, NOW(), #{currentUser}, 'UD17UpdateRole', NOW(), #{currentUser}, 'UD17UpdateRole')

INSERT INTO hdoc_market_auth (USERID, MARKET, `TYPE`, BU, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS) VALUES (#{userid}, #{market}, #{type}, 'UD', NOW(), #{currentUser}, 'UD17UpdateRole', NOW(), #{currentUser}, 'UD17UpdateRole')
